research_question: Does the sign of the median C00 rank-1-minus-rank-2 OOF return over each of the three immediately preceding completed months define a slow monthly state that improves one-slot forward net return over frozen C00 rank 1?

authority.reason: v1.6 and v1.7 reverse the C00 rank-1/rank-2 ordering, but those viewed periods cannot establish that a lagged state predicts genuinely later outcomes.

diagnosis.supported_inference: A fixed rank-2 premium is not stable across the two adjacent registered periods.
diagnosis.unsupported_inference: The two periods alone do not show that the polarity is a persistent, observable, or profitable slow state.

hypothesis.statement: C00 rank-1-minus-rank-2 polarity is not a fixed premium; its sign is a slow monthly state observable from strictly lagged OOF rank differences.
hypothesis.null: The lagged three-month state does not improve forward one-slot net return over C00 rank 1.
alternative_explanations_not_resolved_by: order-statistic noise at the top of C00

fitted_pipeline.refit_rule: Fit each step exactly once for a target month and never refit, partially fit, replace, or mutate any step within that month.

c00_contract.universe: exact v1.7 C00 price-score eligibility, D-1 membership, coverage, continuous-history, missing-value, cross-sectional-rank, and tie behavior
c00_contract.frozen_pair: the first two distinct eligible codes after score_sort
c00_contract.pair_failure: An exact two-row pair of distinct codes and finite scores is mandatory. Any missing/invalid pair is an integrity abort; rank3, cash fallback, or caller replacement is forbidden.

fold_model_bundle_contract.path_rule: One create-once project-canonical JSON file named YYYY-MM.json per target month; pickle, joblib, executable code, and an estimator object are forbidden.
fold_model_bundle_contract.numeric_array_schema: Each of imputer_statistics, imputer_indicator_features, scaler_mean, scaler_scale, and ridge_coef is an object with exactly dtype, shape, values, and sha256. sha256 is project-canonical JSON SHA-256 of that object with only sha256 omitted. Values are row-major JSON numbers, allow_nan=false.

fixed_component_rules.imputer_indicator_features: dtype int64, shape [K], strictly increasing unique original-feature indexes in [0,14] exactly as SimpleImputer.indicator_.features_

fixed_component_rules.scaler_scale: dtype float64, shape [15+K], all values finite and strictly positive

fold_model_bundle_contract.bundle_hash_rule: fold_model_bundle_sha256 is project-canonical JSON SHA-256 with only fold_model_bundle_sha256 omitted. The fold manifest separately binds the exact persisted file-byte SHA-256.
fold_model_bundle_contract.runtime_binding_rule: runtime_lock_sha256 equals runtime_lock_contract.file_sha256 and runtime_lock_verified_at proves a successful exact lock verification before fit or bundle reuse. fold_model_bundle_contract.reconstruction_rule: A clean implementation must reproduce every target-month score using only the registered input feature order and the numeric arrays/scalars in this bundle, with no sklearn object deserialisation. Any non-finite statistic, unexpected shape/order/dtype, component hash mismatch, or score mismatch is an integrity abort.

c00_contract.fold_manifest_seal_rule: A create-once numeric bundle and fold manifest, bound to the exact month-source snapshot and sealed causally before the month cutoff, are mandatory for every counted month. Missing/late/invalid/conflicting artifacts abort; no null-fold month, later transition, or retrospective repair exists.
c00_contract.score_runtime_rule: prepare-day writes one create-once exact two-row score-session shard, then exact-heals the cumulative CSV derived view. Decision/core bind shard file SHA, semantic SHA, and cumulative ordered set SHA. Missing/extra/torn/conflicting score authority aborts.

state_contract.complete_pair_rule: A day contributes exactly one d_t only when that day's C00 pair was sealed before cutoff, the codes are distinct, both operator-attested labeled target open-to-close returns are finite and observed, and neither rank is cash or source/model invalid. Otherwise the day contributes no d_t; it is never zero-filled.
state_contract.calendar_month_rule: Group d_t by target-session Asia/Tokyo calendar month.
state_contract.monthly_statistic: ordinary numeric median of d_t; for even n use the arithmetic mean of the two central sorted finite values
state_contract.unavailable_month_rule: A completed month with fewer than 10 complete pairs has null monthly_median_rank1_minus_rank2_pct and is unavailable.
state_contract.consecutive_rule: For target month M use exactly M-3, M-2, and M-1. Do not skip an unavailable month and do not reach farther back.
state_contract.state_formula: state_value_pct is the ordinary numeric median of the three available monthly medians.
state_contract.zero_rule: Compare the finite IEEE-754 value to exact numeric zero; there is no epsilon, neutral band, or sign fallback.
state_contract.monthly_freeze: Seal state_value_pct and selected_source_rank before the first counted session cutoff of target month M; keep both unchanged for every counted session in M.
state_contract.strict_lag_rule: No target-month outcome, partial target-month aggregate, target-date price, or later revision may enter target month M's state.
state_contract.forward_month_rule: After activation, only pre-open-sealed C00 pairs from counted sessions may enter a completed-month median. Pre-activation or unlogged sessions are never backfilled.
state_contract.historical_seed_rollforward_rule: The three bound v1.7 seed summaries remain eligible without recomputation whenever their calendar month is one of the target month's exact three immediately prior months, then roll off naturally. Thus May is usable for August only, June for August and September, and July for August, September, and October. A missing intervening forward month is unavailable and cannot be skipped to retain an older seed.
state_contract.historical_seed_exception: The 2026-07 seed is a transparent, fixed historical exception: v1.7 stopped on 2026-07-27, so its registered July summary uses only 2026-07-01 through 2026-07-27 and 18 complete pairs, not the full July calendar month. It is accepted solely because the exact v1.7 picks bytes were bound before v1.8. Every forward completed-month record must instead cover all counted scheduled sessions through the registered calendar month-end; this partial-month exception can never recur or be used to shorten a forward month.
state_contract.sealed_online_update: prepare-day attaches the exact prior counted outcome and closes a completed prior month before deriving target-month state. finalize-terminal handles T. Missing prior outcome/close aborts; target-month data never enters its own state.
state_contract.state_manifest_hash_rule: state_manifest_sha256 is project-canonical JSON SHA-256 with only state_manifest_sha256 omitted.
state_contract.state_manifest_existence_and_nullability: Exactly one valid create-once state manifest exists for every represented month and always binds non-null on-time fold/bundle hashes. All three prior-month arrays are present. An unavailable prior month yields state_available=false/state=null/rank=null and cash_state_unavailable; exact zero yields cash_state_zero. Source, fold, pair, outcome, or close failure is not state unavailability and aborts.

append_only_artifacts.chain_rule: Decision, outcome, and completed-month records are authoritative create-once per-key JSON shards with zero-based sequence and previous/self hashes. JSONL ledgers are exact recoverable derived views rebuilt from ordered shards; torn suffixes heal, while missing/extra/reordered/divergent/aliased shards or ledgers abort.
append_only_artifacts.completed_month_chain_rule: The completed-month ledger uses completed_month, not session_date, as its unique chronological key. It contains exactly one record for every forward represented month after that registered month-end, ordered by completed_month with zero-based contiguous sequence_number and the common chain rule. This explicitly includes the terminal represented month even though no later state consumes it: terminal evaluation cannot begin until the terminal-month record covers every counted scheduled session through terminal_session and is create-once hash-sealed. Historical May-through-July seed objects are activation-bound inputs and are not retroactively inserted into this forward ledger.
append_only_artifacts.one_record_per_session_rule: Each counted session has exactly one decision authority shard and, after its operator-attested labeled outcome is attached, one outcome shard. Completed months have one YYYY-MM shard. Exact retry reuses the retained dynamic fields/bytes; key conflicts abort.
append_only_artifacts.sealing_rule: The preregistered May-through-July seed values and initial August 2026 state are public exceptions. After activation, outcome, completed-month, state, score, picks, decision, and checkpoint-core contents that reveal a forward-derived state, selected code, return, failure reason, or performance are access-sealed until terminal unseal. Public Git checkpoint proposals contain only nonce-protected opaque external-object commitments and non-sensitive authorities; nonce/core/core hash never appear there. Before terminal, humans may inspect only scheduled-count, file existence, byte counts, opaque hashes, Git/workflow health, chain continuity, and source health counts that do not reveal a candidate selection or return.
append_only_artifacts.overwrite_rule: Final authority bytes are create-once. Private staging is nonauthority while final is absent and may be safely discarded/rebuilt under the registered lock. A proven final+same-inode staging nlink2 crash marker may be healed; exact complete retry is validation-only. Conflict, unexplained alias, unsafe uid/mode, or divergent bytes abort. Remote Git mutations are never retried.
append_only_artifacts.result_write_rule: A pass/rejection result is sealed only after full terminal reconstruction. Post-C abort is an irreversible outcome-blind termination. Completed exact result retry preserves retained runtime timestamp/bytes; an abort status blocks evaluate before semantic/performance I/O.
append_only_artifacts.score_session_authority: One exact 0600 D.csv shard per counted session is authority; score_output is only its exact ordered derived view and is healed/rejected under the same rules.

stop_rule.integrity_failure: Any missing/partial/ambiguous source, prior outcome, month close, fold/bundle, score pair, checkpoint, protocol/runtime/DAG/hash/chain/alias/permission conflict irreversibly aborts the activated experiment; none becomes cash or later repair. Canonical post-C abort records only outcome-blind fingerprints and consumes the attempt. A new protocol/A-B-C/fresh window is required.
stop_rule.specification_change: Changing a candidate, control, formula, month threshold, lookback, alpha, feature, universe, fit schedule, daily checkpoint role/path/core/eligibility/resolution rule, cost, block length, gate, source, start, or terminal rule ends this protocol. A new protocol, preregistration, activation, and entirely new forward counter are required.
stop_rule.terminal_evaluation: Unseal and evaluate exactly once only after exact terminal runtime validation and full validation of the terminal-inclusive completed-month record. Then independently recompute exact picks, input bindings, metrics, result object, and canonical bytes. If SH01 fails any gate, reject it; do not reopen the period, change a gate, nominate a control, or add a candidate.
stop_rule.after_pass: A pass authorises only preregistration of unchanged SH01 for a new, non-overlapping v1.9 sealed confirmation. It does not authorise production or orders.
stop_rule.after_failure: A failure rejects this shoulder-state formula. Further selection on the same fresh outcomes is exploratory only and cannot inherit fresh confirmation authority.
